newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-BORDER 258-3 AT TEA AGAINST NATAL.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-BORDER 258-3 AT TEA AGAINST NATAL.

text.p: Border, chasing 385 to win, were comfortably placed on 258 for three in their second innings at tea on the final day of their four-day Supersport Series cricket match against Natal at Kingsmead on Monday.

Natal 332 (Dale Benkenstein 129, Mark Bruyns 73, Shaun Pollock 66; Vasbert Drakes 8-59) and 257 (Shaun Pollock 77, Doug Watson 75). Border 205 and 258 for three (Frans Cronje 67, Peter Kirsten 72 not out, Pieter Strydom 46 not out).
